name: Parasite (Trypanosoma)
short_description: Single-celled protozoan parasite — a Trypanosoma brucei trypomastigote with a true nucleus, one flagellum, an undulating membrane and a kinetoplast.

textbook.1: ✅ PASS — slender trypomastigote cutaway: true nucleus, tubular mitochondrion, small posterior kinetoplast, one flagellum along the undulating membrane; correct T. brucei.

sem.1: ✅ PASS — single elongated cell, flagellar ridge (undulating membrane) along the body, free flagellum; surface only.

3d.1: ✅ PASS — translucent spindle cell: nucleus, kinetoplast posterior to the nucleus, single flagellum + undulating membrane.

watercolor.1: ❌ FAIL — dark charcoal frame around the paper + a bristly ciliate-like fringe.
watercolor.2: ✅ PASS — no border; single spindle cell, one trailing flagellum, nucleus, small kinetoplast, undulating-membrane fold; smooth pellicle.
watercolor.3: ✅ PASS — re-rendered full-bleed on aged paper (no sheet/border), cocci/rod style; single spindle cell, flagellum, undulating membrane, nucleus, kinetoplast, tubular mitochondrion.

reference: ✅ PASS — Giemsa blood smear with several Trypanosoma trypomastigotes among red blood cells (CDC PHIL #613, Public Domain); classic scale-vs-RBC teaching view; no baked-in text.
